player_prompt.intro:
Mo ye zo Joueur {player_id} na SimpleTak.
Na mbëtï, pöpö tï zo ake '{player_stone}' na pöpö tï zo adversaire ake '{opponent_stone}'.

Na tour tï zo, tïa mbïï cellule vide (na nimëro tï ndö) na tïa pöpö tï zo na pé.
Közo, '[12]' tïa pöpö tï zo na cellule 12.

Objectif tï zo ake former chemin continu tï pöpö tï zo zo connecter deux bords opposés tï mbëtï (haut-bas ou gauche-droite).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: A yeke na lege ni ape ti zia zo kâ
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Namba ti seli {cell_num} ati mo. Eka ti na kati na 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: A zia mbeni ye na yâ ti cellule {cell_num} awe. Soro mbeni senge cellule ni.

action.placement: Mbeni {current_player_id} akisi ti mbeti ({symbol}) na kôti {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Joueur {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') a connecté deux bords opposés!
outcome.draw: A mû ye kue na yâ ti tableau ni.
